spots.name: Hyde Park Falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt.

spots.name: Barillas Lookout
spots.tip: A lookout tower or fire lookout: a full-circle view, so it works at sunrise and sunset. Many are staffed in summer and some can be rented.

spots.name: Viewpoint (2877 m)
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint facing east. Good for sunrise. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: Nambe Falls Reservoir
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. The pin marks the middle of the lake: pick a shore spot facing the light.

spots.name: Montezuma Hot Springs
spots.tip: Steam reads best in cold air at first light. Check access rules; many springs are on private or tribal land.

spots.name: Galisteo Basin Preserve
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: Bear Cave
spots.tip: A cave entrance. Bring a headlamp and a tripod; light from the opening makes the picture. Check whether it's closed for bats or ice.
